news.title: Two Groups of bitcoin Investors sell on the rise as U.S. inflation lifts prices to nearly $65,000
news.summary: Bitcoin surges toward $65,000 on softer-than-expected inflation data, but on-chain signals show two key investor groups selling into the bounce.

news.title: Coinbase's Jesse Pollak steps back from Base app leadership after admitting his crypto social strategy failed
news.summary: Pollak said that Jordan Fish, also known on X as 'Cobie,' will lead the Base app team.

news.title: DTCC moves tokenized securities into live trading, marking a milestone for Wall Street's blockchain push
news.summary: DTCC's first live production trades using tokenized securities show how blockchain could reshape the infrastructure behind Wall Street.

news.title: Cantor and Securitize collaborate on blockchain-based IPOs
news.summary: The move creates a pathway for public companies to raise capital onchain and issue tokenized securities.

news.title: Ostium suffers $18 million exploit as oracle attack wave continues to hit DeFi
news.summary: A hacker used Ostium's own price-reporting infrastructure against the protocol, submitting falsified future-dated oracle data to manufacture fake trading profits and trigger an $18 million payout.

news.title: The privacy paradox of protecting kids online
news.summary: We don’t need to imagine the privacy pitfalls of age verification. They’ve been happening for years, argues Cardano Foundation CEO Frederik Gregaard.

news.title: Crypto Long & Short: To ETH or not to ETH — is SOL the better diversifier?
news.summary: In this week's, Morgan Stanley’s Denny Galindo writes that as the crypto market expands, solana has historically been a better portfolio diversifier than ether, despite being more volatile.

news.title: President Trump expected to meet with senators to work on ethics concerns in crypto bill
news.summary: The most contentious piece of the crypto market structure bill is unresolved in the final weeks of Senate runway, and the president is expected to discuss it.

news.title: AI is so big, it’s now impossible for investors to avoid
news.summary: Exposure to the artificial-intelligence boom has become virtually impossible for investors to avoid. The theme hasn’t just cornered the stock market. It has systematically swallowed up corporate credit and venture capital, too.

news.title: United Airlines gets hit by a $6 billion added-fuel-cost headwind
news.summary: Investors zero in on United’s potentially fatter jet-fuel bill — the airline said it expects nearly $6 billion in additional fuel expenses for the year.

news.title: The trucking market is tighter than it’s been in years — but investors are upbeat on J.B. Hunt
news.summary: Shares of the trucking giant jump 8% after hours, as fuel charges and demand for its railroad-connection business lift results

news.summary: “Since her death, her bank balance fell to $9,000 from $16,000.”

news.title: ‘I don’t want to sound callous’: Why base your Social Security claim on life expectancy? We could die at any time.
news.summary: “The actual date of death ultimately affects only the surviving beneficiaries.”

news.title: Your Netflix bill is up 29% in just over a year. It’s time for Washington to step in.
news.summary: Netflix is still a Wall Street favorite — and a target for government regulators
